payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how the proposed training framework mitigates the bias pattern in natural language inference datasets by balancing annotation artifacts across labels.

claims.text: The proposed training framework mitigates the bias pattern by balancing annotation artifacts across different classes using specific weights for each sample during training.
The framework improves the generalization ability of models by effectively addressing the impacts of annotation artifacts in cross-dataset testing without requiring additional data or annotations.
